title: LUMEN: a browser shader studio with nine WebGL2 art modes that exports seamless loops to PNG, WebM

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: You want a slick animated background for a video, a site header, or an album cover, and your options are paying for stock loops or fighting a 3D app for an hour. Lumen just makes it. It's a generative shader studio that runs in your browser with nine WebGL2 art modes: liquid chrome, silk, halftone, data glyphs, and more. Every animation is a perfect seamless loop, and you export straight to PNG, WebM, or GIF. No watermark. No
